positions.name: Marvell Technology
positions.catalyst: First full session pricing Thursday's dovish June jobs shock (57k vs 115k consensus) + ISM prices plunge (82.1->73), driving aggressive Fed rate-cut repricing and a broad risk-on tape (Nasdaq 100 +1.1% pre-mkt, ~76% odds of an up open). AI-semi leaders bid; MRVL +3.4% pre-mkt on the rotation into high-beta/AI compute names.
positions.driver: Highest-torque liquid expression of the rate-cut risk-on move with secular AI-compute demand behind it; up a modest ~3.4% pre-mkt so not chasing an extended gap, room to run into the open. Deep liquidity gives a clean, enforceable stop — unlike a binary biotech.
positions.risks: Catalyst is macro, not company-specific — if the weak-jobs read flips to a growth-scare narrative, high-beta semis fall hardest. Broad-market/AI-sentiment beta. Hard stop 6% below entry.
